title: PNB Bank LBO Online Form 2026 – Date Extend
vacancyDetails: Local Bank Officer posts in JMGS cadre for state/language-specific recruitment as per PNB notification
qualification: Graduation and local language proficiency as required in PNB LBO advertisement
ageLimit: As per PNB LBO notification (category relaxations apply)
applicationFee: As per PNB online application fee
selectionProcess: Online Exam → Language Proficiency Test / Interview → Final Selection

howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.pnbindia.in Careers
2. Open LBO recruitment apply online

shortDescription: PNB Bank LBO Online Form 2026 – apply for Local Bank Officer posts on pnbindia.in careers section.
content:
Punjab National Bank (PNB) has invited online applications for Local Bank Officer (LBO) recruitment.

Candidates must satisfy educational and local language requirements of the applied state/circle. Selection typically includes online examination and language proficiency assessment.
